judgement.summary: The transcript is of extremely poor quality. Almost all names of people, companies, and locations are severely garbled, often turning into unrelated Finnish words. Important details like the target audience, duration of the course, and critical negative statements are completely lost or reversed. Whole sentences are reduced to incomprehensible word salad. The text is largely unusable for extracting factual information about the courses.
